topic: Does your frame fit? 3 checks (width, bridge, temples)

youtube.title: Does your frame fit? 3 quick checks 👓 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Does your frame really fit? 3 quick checks. 👓
உங்கள் கண்ணாடி ஃப்ரேம் சரியாக பொருந்துகிறதா?

• Fit matters: the centre of each lens must sit in front of your pupil for clear, comfortable vision.
• 1. Width: about as wide as your face, no pressing on the temples, no gaps.
• 2. Bridge: rests on your nose without sliding down or leaving red marks.
• 3. Temples: the arms curve softly behind your ears, without pain.
